source.publication: 2025 Schedule M1M Income Additions and Subtractions
source.section: Form M1 lines 1-4, 7-10 (instructions PDF p.13 Standard Deduction Table for Line 4, p.14 Worksheet A, p.39 Tax Rate Schedules, pp.32-38 tax table); Schedule M1M line 25 (M1M PDF p.7 'Line 25 - Military Pension or Retirement Pay'); Form M1 instructions PDF p.26 'Military Pensions'

worked: Each spouse's military pension is subtracted in full; no cap and no age test. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 40,000.00 + pension 50,000.00 = 90,000.00. Federal taxable income = 90,000.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction (31,500 plus 0 x 1,600) = 58,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form M1, married filing jointly: line 1 federal AGI 90,000.00. Schedule M1M line 1 other-state municipal interest 0.00; line 10 additions 0.00; Form M1 line 2 0.00; line 3 = 90,000.00. Schedule M1M line 16: no one is 65 or older (born before January 2, 1961), so no Schedule M1R subtraction. Schedule M1M line 25 military pension 50,000.00, included in federal AGI. Schedule M1M line 40 = Form M1 line 7 subtractions = 0.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 + 50,000.00 = 50,000.00 (lines 12, 16, 17, 25). State income before deduction = 90,000.00 - 50,000.00 = 40,000.00. Standard Deduction Table for Line 4 (PDF p.13): base 29,900.00; AGI is not over 238,950.00, so no Worksheet A. Line 4 = 29,900.00. Form M1 line 8 total = 29,900.00 + 50,000.00 = 79,900.00; line 9 Minnesota taxable income = 90,000.00 - 79,900.00 = 10,100.00. Line 10 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.39): 5.35% x (10,100.00 - 0.00) = 540.35 = 540.35. The tax table (PDF pp.32-38) gives 543; expected keeps the schedule formula. Line 16 credits 0.00 (the joint-filer Schedule M1C credit is not in the sources and is not applied); state income tax 540.35.
accepted_approximations: Tax comes from the rate schedules at every income; below 86,800 of taxable income the booklet requires its 100-wide tax table.
The Schedule M1C credit for joint filers is not applied because its amount is not in the sources.
